hero.headline: Freight that keeps its promises
hero.sub: Ocean, air and road freight for shippers who need a partner that answers the phone at 2am. From Kampala to over 120 countries, we move cargo — and we own every mile of the paperwork.

services.name: Ocean Freight
services.desc: FCL and LCL container shipping across every major trade lane, with consolidation out of Mombasa and Dar es Salaam.

services.name: Air Freight
services.desc: Time-critical cargo on scheduled and charter flights, with priority handling for perishables and pharma.

services.name: Road & Rail
services.desc: Cross-border trucking across the East African Community, plus rail links to inland container depots.

services.name: Warehousing & Distribution
services.desc: Bonded and general warehousing with pick-pack-ship fulfilment for regional distribution.

services.name: Customs Brokerage
services.desc: Licensed clearing agents handling documentation, duty calculation and compliance at every border post.

services.name: Project & Heavy-Lift Cargo
services.desc: Engineering, route surveys and permits for oversized, high-value and industrial cargo movements.

testimonials.quote: Trance Logistics cleared a 40-foot container through three border posts in a week when we'd budgeted a month. That's the difference between a vendor and a partner.
testimonials.author: Grace Nakimuli

testimonials.quote: We moved our first air freight shipment with them on a Sunday night emergency. They picked up the phone. That's rare in this industry.
testimonials.author: Daniel Osei
testimonials.company: Supply Chain Manager, Nova Retail Group

testimonials.quote: Their customs team knows the Malaba and Busia posts better than our own staff do. Fewer delays, fewer surprises on the invoice.
testimonials.author: Miriam Achieng

about.headline: Built by people who've stood at the border post at 4am
about.story: Trance Logistics started with a single truck route between Kampala and Mombasa, run by a team that had spent years watching cargo get stuck — not because of distance, but because of paperwork nobody owned. We built the company around a simple rule: every shipment gets one point of contact, from quote to final mile, regardless of how many borders, ports or airlines it touches.
about.mission: To move cargo for East African businesses with the reliability of a global carrier and the responsiveness of a local partner.

values.title: One point of contact
values.desc: You speak to one coordinator for the life of the shipment, not a rotating queue.

values.title: We own the paperwork
values.desc: Licensed customs brokers on staff at every major border and port we operate through.

values.title: No surprise invoices
values.desc: Landed cost quoted up front, including duties, handling and last-mile delivery.
